imagegen.prompt: Create ONE production VFX texture asset: a single vertically rising realistic flame plume, isolated with genuinely transparent alpha background, no ground, no text, no frame. Warm orange and amber flowing wispy fire with detailed dark-orange internal structure, small pale-yellow hottest regions only, curling tongues and broken tapering edges. The plume occupies central 70% of a square canvas, its base centered near bottom quarter. Restrained exposure, avoid broad white blobs. Intended as a reusable particle billboard in a real-time game engine; clean alpha with soft translucent fringes, coherent shape readable when reduced to 128 pixels. No smoke cloud, no sparks, no scene lighting.
